content:
Although iOS 27 is already the main focus of preview software, Apple is still preparing the next iPhone update, iOS 26.6. Apple has released the first candidate version of iOS 26.6. The iOS 26.6 beta has been in testing since late May.

iOS 26.6 Features and Changes

So far we have discovered two notable changes in the iOS 26.6 beta.

First, an adjustment to the upper limit on the number of contacts that can be blocked. Second, a new iPhone anti-theft feature appears to be in development.

This update may also involve preparations for Spotlight indexing on iPhone and iPad, so that Siri AI can use it in iOS 27. Today's release candidate confirms this for the first time in the public release notes.

We expect there won't be many more new features and changes, as all focus has now shifted to iOS 27.

Apple's next major software update will arrive in September, by which time Apple will have been continuously refining iOS 27 throughout the summer.

iOS 26.6 will be the next release, following the iOS 26 launched last fall and its subsequent updates.

Last year, iOS 18.6 beta 1 was released after iOS 26 beta 1, meaning that iOS 26.6 is on a slightly earlier schedule than Apple's 2025 release cycle.
